candidateSegments.teachingRole: Wheel/body relative motion gives concrete motivation for spring and damper.

observed.action: Wheels rise and fall relative to body as vehicle crosses the surface.
observed.result: Body oscillates while continuing across bumps.

claimLimits: Continuous road input prevents claiming free-decay or critical damping from the visible motion.

annotationPlan.target: Wheel centre and body edge, short relative-travel bracket; do not cover suspension/road.
annotationPlan.style: Progressive open contour/short leader/path with labels. No invented game measurements or internal force/skeleton data.
annotationPlan.tracking: These inspected sample frames are planning evidence, not per-frame tracking. Follow actual target; hide at occlusion/out-of-frame; clear at cut.
annotationPlan.captionClearance: Fixed bottom-centre captions and game UI protected; foreground callout should not cover the action.
